relations.subject: Bhikkhu Bodhi
relations.evidence: He mentored and taught a whole generation of Western Buddhist leaders such as Bhikkhu Bodhi.

relations.subject: Nyanaponika Thera
relations.evidence: In 1937 he received Upasampadā (Higher Ordination) under the tutelage of Nyanatiloka Mahathera.

relations.subject: Nyanaponika Thera
relations.evidence: Ven. Nyanaponika Thera stayed in Burma for a period of training in Vipassanā (Insight Meditation) under the meditation teacher Ven. Mahasi Sayadaw Thera.

relations.subject: Nyanaponika Thera
relations.evidence: co-founder of the Buddhist Publication Society

relations.subject: Nyanaponika Thera
relations.evidence: in 1984 he retired as editor of BPS

relations.subject: Nyanaponika Thera
relations.evidence: in 1988 he retired as president, ending his career there with recognition as a Distinguished Patron of BPS.

relations.subject: Nyanaponika Thera
relations.evidence: Thera, Nyanaponika; Bodhi, Bhikkhu (2000). Numerical Discourses of the Buddha. Yale University Press.

relations.subject: Nyanatiloka Mahathera
relations.evidence: Ven. Nyanatiloka Thera had established a monastery for Western monks in Sri Lanka, on an island lagoon (opposite the Railway station) Polgasduwa, Dodanduwa named Island Hermitage.
